summary: API TypeScript quét web và trích xuất dữ liệu thành markdown, nổi bật là cung cấp nguồn dữ liệu sẵn cho AI agent và LLM.
usecases: Feeding real-time web data into LLM prompts for up-to-date knowledge retrieval
Building autonomous AI agents that can research and summarize topics from the web
Extracting structured data from websites for training machine learning datasets
ideas: Create a self-healing RAG pipeline that automatically scrapes and updates knowledge bases
Develop a browser-automation alternative that bypasses anti-bot measures for academic research
Combine with vector databases to enable semantic search over live web content
